devdoc.details: Extends PriceOracleAbstract to provide price data specifically for Layer 2 networks, incorporating sequencer uptime feeds to ensure data reliability.

constructor.details: Initializes the contract with Layer 2 specific settings.

params._WETH: Address of the WETH token for price reference.
params._sequencerUptimeFeed: Address of the Sequencer Uptime Feed Aggregator.

params.amountIn: The amount of base tokens to be converted to USD

returns.amountOut: The latest USD token price of the base token

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setFeeds(address[],address[],address[]).details: Adds or updates Chainlink price feeds for token pairs.

params.aggregators: Array of Chainlink aggregator contracts for each token pair.
params.quotes: Array of quote token addresses corresponding to each base token.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

updateFeed(address,address,address).details: Updates an existing Chainlink price feed for a token pair.

params.aggregator: The new Chainlink aggregator contract for the token pair.
params.base: The address of the base token.
params.quote: The address of the quote token.

params._newTimeout: New timeout threshold set by owner

devdoc.title: PriceOracleL2

IncorrectArrayLength().notice: Throws when the array lenghts don't match for adding price feed or enabling tokens

PriceOracleExpired().notice: Throws when the oracle price is not updated under set timeout

PriceOracleInvalid().notice: Throws when the oracle price is returned 0

SequencerThresholdNotCrossed().notice: Throws when sequencer threshold is not crossed

convertToUSD18Decimals(address,uint256).notice: Returns the latest USD price for a specific token and amount

decimals(address,address).notice: Returns the decimals of a token pair price feed
